marketSummary: Indian equities display strong momentum ahead of the upcoming RBI MPC rate decision, with benchmark indices clearing short-term resistance. Strength is primarily concentrated in consumption, retail, and FMCG names driven by robust early Q2 business updates, while banking contends with margin contraction concerns and IPO newsflow gathers momentum.

news.headline: LIC mints Rs 531 crore in one day as Trent shares rally 13%; insurance behemoth’s stake value nears Rs 4,700 cr

news.impact: Massive volume expansion on operational milestone provides strong continuation momentum for multi-day swing setups.

news.headline: Dabur shares rise 4% as firm sees double-digit Q2 growth; FMCG set for strong performance

news.impact: Double-digit earnings guidance acts as an accumulation catalyst, encouraging base breakout attempts in the stock.

news.headline: Ambani’s Jio said to seek about Rs 11 lakh crore valuation in IPO
news.summary: Jio Platforms is seeking an IPO valuation of approximately ₹11 lakh crore ($114B) with plans to launch in mid-October and list before October 30.
news.impact: Imminent mega-IPO timeline provides strong valuation support and holding-company upside for parent Reliance.

news.headline: Honasa surges 8% after flagging strong Q2 revenue, margin improvement

news.impact: Immediate legal relief removes an overhang, opening a high-probability mean-reversion bounce setup.
